# Task-based executor requires threading support.
if(NOT IREE_ENABLE_THREADING)
  return()
endif()

iree_add_all_subdirs()

# cpuinfo can be conditionally disabled when it is not supported.
# If disabled then by default the task system will use 1 thread.
set(IREE_CPUINFO_TARGET)
if(IREE_ENABLE_CPUINFO)
  set(IREE_CPUINFO_TARGET cpuinfo)
endif()

# Mirrors :expanded_sysfs_snapshots.
if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
  # Keep in sync with the manifests list of :expanded_sysfs_snapshots.
  set(_IREE_TASK_SYSFS_MANIFEST_NAMES
      "arm64_pixel6_tensor"
      "synthetic_big_little"
      "synthetic_dual_socket"
      "synthetic_dual_socket_no_siblings"
      "synthetic_fragmented_cpulist"
      "synthetic_invalid_package"
      "synthetic_memory_only_node"
      "synthetic_meteor_lake"
      "synthetic_raptor_lake"
      "synthetic_snc"
      "synthetic_sparse_node_ids"
      "synthetic_too_many_nodes"
      "x86_64_ryzen9_7950x")
  set(_IREE_TASK_SYSFS_MANIFESTS)
  foreach(_IREE_TASK_SYSFS_NAME ${_IREE_TASK_SYSFS_MANIFEST_NAMES})
    list(APPEND _IREE_TASK_SYSFS_MANIFESTS
         "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/testdata/sysfs/${_IREE_TASK_SYSFS_NAME}.sysfs.txt")
  endforeach()
  set(_IREE_TASK_SYSFS_EXPAND_DIR
      "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/expanded_sysfs_snapshots")
  set(_IREE_TASK_SYSFS_STAMP "${_IREE_TASK_SYSFS_EXPAND_DIR}.stamp")
  set(_IREE_TASK_SYSFS_EXPAND_COMMANDS)
  foreach(_IREE_TASK_SYSFS_MANIFEST ${_IREE_TASK_SYSFS_MANIFESTS})
    get_filename_component(_IREE_TASK_SYSFS_BASENAME
                           "${_IREE_TASK_SYSFS_MANIFEST}" NAME)
    string(REPLACE ".sysfs.txt" "" _IREE_TASK_SYSFS_NAME
           "${_IREE_TASK_SYSFS_BASENAME}")
    list(APPEND _IREE_TASK_SYSFS_EXPAND_COMMANDS
         COMMAND bash
                 "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/testdata/sysfs/capture_sysfs.sh"
                 --expand "${_IREE_TASK_SYSFS_MANIFEST}"
                 "${_IREE_TASK_SYSFS_EXPAND_DIR}/${_IREE_TASK_SYSFS_NAME}")
  endforeach()
  add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT "${_IREE_TASK_SYSFS_STAMP}"
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E rm -rf "${_IREE_TASK_SYSFS_EXPAND_DIR}"
    ${_IREE_TASK_SYSFS_EXPAND_COMMANDS}
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E touch "${_IREE_TASK_SYSFS_STAMP}"
    DEPENDS ${_IREE_TASK_SYSFS_MANIFESTS}
            "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/testdata/sysfs/capture_sysfs.sh"
    COMMENT "Expanding sysfs snapshot manifests")
  add_custom_target(iree_runtime_task_expanded_sysfs_snapshots ALL
                    DEPENDS "${_IREE_TASK_SYSFS_STAMP}")
endif()

# Only linux tests with task topology snapshots.
set(_IREE_TASK_TOPOLOGY_TEST_ARGS)
if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
  list(APPEND _IREE_TASK_TOPOLOGY_TEST_ARGS
       "--task_topology_test_snapshots=${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/expanded_sysfs_snapshots")
endif()

### BAZEL_TO_CMAKE_PRESERVES_ALL_CONTENT_BELOW_THIS_LINE ###

# Topology implementation selection.
# All topology sources are compiled unconditionally (required for Bazel).
# Files self-select based on platform guards and IREE_HAVE_CPUINFO.
#
# Priority (first match wins):
# 1. cpuinfo (if IREE_ENABLE_CPUINFO=ON)
# 2. sysfs (Linux/Android, excluding Emscripten/Wasm)
# 3. Platform-specific (Darwin, Windows, Wasm)
# 4. Fallback (single-threaded conservative topology)

if(IREE_ENABLE_CPUINFO)
  target_compile_definitions(iree_task_task PRIVATE IREE_TASK_USE_CPUINFO=1)
  message(STATUS "IREE task topology: using cpuinfo")
elseif(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux" AND NOT EMSCRIPTEN AND NOT IREE_ARCH STREQUAL "wasm_32")
  message(STATUS "IREE task topology: using sysfs (Linux)")
elseif(APPLE)
  message(STATUS "IREE task topology: using platform-specific (Darwin)")
elseif(WIN32)
  message(STATUS "IREE task topology: using platform-specific (Windows)")
elseif(EMSCRIPTEN OR IREE_ARCH STREQUAL "wasm_32")
  message(STATUS "IREE task topology: using platform-specific (Wasm)")
else()
  message(STATUS "IREE task topology: using fallback (single-threaded)")
endif()
